scope: Theorem 4.1 (Critical-radius comparison) of the manuscript “Replacing Gaussian observations in memory-constrained inference” (preprints/Replacing-Gaussian-observations-in-memory-constrained-inference-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 140 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 623197ae012dfb0c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In the two experiments of Subsection 2.2, use the dimensions (18). Thus S ∼ σ, A ∼ γm is independent of S, and W is countable with an arbitrary joint dependence on (S, A). The aligned law retains (S, A, W) and appends independent r-row C, whereas the independent law retains (S, W) and draws an independent ℓ-row matrix G. If H(W) ≤ d2, then, for an absolute constant K, I0(S; W | G, GS) ≤ I1(S; W | G, GS) + Kd. (19)
